observed.caption: A tall cylindrical tower with a disc-shaped top stands in the center of a paved plaza surrounded by modern buildings, palm trees, and a statue on a pedestal under a partly cloudy sky.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor urban plaza with a prominent tall cylindrical building with horizontal balconies and a wide flat roof in the center, a large circular building with a brown conical roof to its right, and two additional high-rise buildings behind it including a curved glass tower with a blue facade on the far right and a rectangular light-colored tower. In the left foreground a seated statue sits atop a tall stone pedestal, while the paved plaza in the foreground holds several parked light-colored cars, numerous thin flagpoles, clusters of palm trees, and a few small figures of people walking. Low-rise buildings are visible in the left background, and the sky above is filled with white and gray clouds with patches of blue.
